name: The Damned
label: Quest
description: New Forsaken in Deathknell turn to Novice Elreth for clothing and battlefield wraps. She trades salvaged armor for the materials needed to make them.

clips.title: The story
paras: New Forsaken in Deathknell turn to Novice Elreth for clothing and battlefield wraps. She trades salvaged armor for the materials needed to make them.

Novice Elreth tends the newly risen Forsaken in Deathknell. She assists Shadow Priest Sarvis, cares for battered soldiers, and mends their garments. Supplies run short, so she sends you into the surrounding glades to hunt duskbats and scavenger wolves. Their pelts, wings, and sinew help keep the camp supplied, and Elreth offers salvaged armor in return.

Elreth's armor has already belonged to Forsaken who did not survive their awakening. She hopes it serves you better than its previous owner. In Tirisfal Glades, every piece of leather and rusted chain is put to use.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... Hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. This armor should help you out.
Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...
